title: emoAIsec: Fortifying Real-Time Customer Experience Optimization with Emotion AI and Data Security
content: Businesses today use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to enhance customer interactions. Emotion AI, a branch of AI, recognizes human emotions through text, voice, and facial expressions, enabling personalized and engaging experiences. While this increases customer satisfaction, it also raises privacy and security concerns. To address these challenges, we propose emoAIsec, a framework that integrates Emotion AI with strong data protection measures. It employs encryption, privacy-focused analytics, and legal compliance to ensure ethical AI-powered customer interactions. emoAIsec consists of three key modules: Emotion Recognition, Customer Experience Optimization, and Data Security. Emotion Recognition analyzes emotions using deep learning with high accuracy, outperforming existing models in real-time emotion detection. Customer Experience Optimization dynamically adjusts responses, enhancing customer satisfaction and reducing churn. Data Security ensures safe handling of emotional data through federated learning and differential privacy, setting a new benchmark for secure AI-driven interactions. Our research highlights emoAIsec unique contributions, including an innovative graph-based approach for multimodal emotion fusion and real-time processing capabilities. These advancements make it a reliable and ethical solution for optimizing customer experience while maintaining data integrity and security.
